name: ESP32

reserved.1: UART0 TX. Carries the USB serial link to Thingstudio.
reserved.3: UART0 RX. Carries the USB serial link to Thingstudio.
reserved.6-11: Wired to the flash chip. Using them crashes the board.

avoid.0: Strapping pin. Held low at reset, the board starts in download mode.
avoid.2: Strapping pin. Must be low or floating at reset to flash the board.
avoid.5: Strapping pin. Sets flash timing at reset.
avoid.12: Strapping pin. High at reset selects 1.8 V flash, and most boards then fail to boot.
avoid.15: Strapping pin. Low at reset silences the boot log.
avoid.16-17: Wired to PSRAM on WROVER modules.

notes: Classic ESP32 (Xtensa LX6). On pins other than the bus's fast pins, SPI tops out near 27 MHz (ESP-IDF rounds 27 MHz down to 26.7 MHz). Asking for more makes ESP-IDF refuse the setting, and the board crashes.
